name: Superior Channel Spirit (Mythic)
body:
You are one with the spirits as an actual medium.

Prerequisite(s): Superior Channel Spirit.

Benefit(s): You use your character level as your medium level for the purpose of gaining and using spirit powers granted by the medium spirit selected with Channel Spirit. In addition, you gain the propitiation ability with your spirit as a medium of your character level.
